title: A rectangle filled with a CMYK color
concept: A named <Color> defined in Graphic.xml, applied to a shape by FillColor.

annotations.note: A process CMYK swatch named Red. Self is the id everything references; Model=Process and Space=CMYK pick the model and space; ColorValue carries the four channel percentages C M Y K, here 0 100 100 0 (pure red).
Black and Paper are the reserved built-ins InDesign writes into every document; the renderer treats them by name even when omitted.
